newsitem.title: USA: Emerging market debt mixed in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: Emerging market debt mixed in cautious trade.

text.p: Weakness in U.S. Treasuries weighed on emerging debts as players marked time for next week's key U.S. data release, traders said.
Major Latin Bradies, which moved in lock step with Treasuries, while high yielders, such as Ecuador, Bulgaria and Russia attracted some trading interest, they said.
In defensive plays, short duration bonds and floaters performed better, which pushed Argentina Discounts AR425C23=RR up 3/4 to bid 81-1/8.
Longer-duration eurbonds like Mexico global 26 lost a whopping 1-3/8 to103-3/4 bid.
Argentina global 17, which rallied in the wake of S&P upgrading a dozen or so corporte issuers on Tuesday, eased 3/8 to 103-7/8 bid.

Amy Falls, director of emerging market fixed income research at Morgan Stanley, said the high yielders were less correlated to the movements in U.S. Treasury and they offer good returns on the relative value basis.
Bulgaria and Russia also benefited from investors putting faith in those countries' long-term credit improvement, she said.

In Ecuador's case, even though there is little momentum in economic reform during interim president Alarcon's government, there would be some gradual privatization to keep the country on the right track, she noted.
While Ecuador PDI ECPDI=RR lost 5/8 to 57-1/8 bid, the less liquid IEB ECIEB=RR gained 3/4 to 86-3/4.

Trading sources said the Ecuador eurobond issued earlier this month did well in the secondary market, which apparently inspired sympathy buying. The IEB and the eurobond have similar short duration, while the duration for the PDI bond is longer, they said.
Bulgaria Bradys, which had a good run before the victory of the reformist Union of Democratic Forces won the election last Saturday, were unchanged to easier.
Bulgaria FLRB BGFLIRG=RR was off 1/8 at 45-1/2 bid.
Russia's dollar Vnesh loans RUVNUSLNS=RR gave up the gains in the European tradidng hours to end 1/2 lower at 78.00 bid. (( -- Nailene Chou Wiest - 212-859-1674))
